name: Harmony 350, does a device key turn Watch TV off
description: On lab/work/350-every-key/every-key.bin, where every key the TV's map left unbound, Watch TV among them, sends the same code as Info. Watch TV sent Info after a battery pull and stopped after a device key press; every earlier test began with TV/Media and heard nothing from it. This test pulls the batteries, presses Watch TV before and after TV/Media, and checks whether a second TV/Media press brings it back. Menu is the control: it is on the same column wire as Watch TV.

steps.instruction: Take the batteries out of the Harmony 350 and put them back, unplugged from USB. Do not press any device key. Point it at the receiver
Press Watch TV once. After a battery pull the remote starts in the TV's mode, and Watch TV is filled in there to send Info
Press TV/Media (top left of the four device keys) once and briefly. Nothing should be heard
Press Watch TV once. If it is silent, pressing TV/Media is enough to turn it off
Press Volume Up once, to show the remote is in the TV's mode
Press TV/Media once more, briefly, then Watch TV once. This shows whether it comes back without a battery pull
Press Menu once, a key on the same wire as Watch TV, as a control
